lines.text: The judges have deliberated over the materials you submitted

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: They found there were multiple inconsistencies within IV's statements,

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: and have thus concluded his argument to be invalid.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: He wove an intricate web of lies.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Had it not been for your call for an additional review, it would have slipped by us unnoticed.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I had assumed that the recent newcomers were all conscientious people.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I did not expect there to be a traitor within our midst.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Has the Assassination Authorization been revoked, then?

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: We will leave it to you on how to proceed.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: The decision is yours to make.
